messages:
maria-devsec: Morning intake: CVE-2026-1423 (libproto) — EPSS 0.11, CVSS 7.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N. Public PoC circulating. Affects model-serving and image-preprocessing containers. Tagging SRE/platform for triage and patch plan.

owen-sre: On it. Can you paste service paths? I can run quick image scan.

maria-devsec: SBOM grep for reference: `jq -r '.packages[] | select(.name=="libproto") | .version' sbom.json` — saw 1.2.3 in model-serving and 1.2.0 in img-preproc.

alisha-qa: Adding smoke/regression for crafted header cases. Will run retest once a patch image is available. Creating GH-4521 for test coverage.

sam-platform: Mitigation plan first: tighten network access and RBAC for the grpc model endpoint (internal-only). I'll open a PR to restrict ServiceAccount permissions + a NetworkPolicy and an audit annotation so we get events in the console.

natalie-secops: Quick KMS check: does libproto path touch any key-derived data? My read is no, but want confirmation. Also please enable KMS decryption audit logs in the canary region (eu-west-1) while we validate.

kevin-ml: Model-serving uses KMS for embedding keys, but libproto lives in preproc container. I don't think key usage is impacted, but I'll confirm with infra and post findings. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline idle. To deploy canary label PR with `cve-candidate` and I can route 10% traffic to us-west-2.

owen-sre: Triage/plan: upgrade to libproto 1.2.4 (upstream fix). Build patched images, push to staging, deploy canary 10% us-west-2 for 30m with replay tests. If errors spike, rollback using INC-1245 playbook.

maria-devsec: Priority: High. Recommended actions: patch + RBAC tighten + network policy + KMS audit enabled for region. Owners assigned: @owen-sre (patch/deploy), @alisha-qa (tests), @sam-platform (RBAC/netpol PR), @kevin-ml (kms confirmation). I'll file SEC-2026-314 and attach EPSS/CVSS evidences and action checklist.

owen-sre: I'll start image build now. Posting logs to GH-4521 when ready.

alisha-qa: Will queue the replay tests and smoke suite once artifact URL is posted.

sam-platform: PR draft up in 10m for RBAC + NetworkPolicy + audit annotations.

maria-devsec: Thanks — please ping here when canary is live. Also enable verbose audit logging for the first hour after deploy so we can capture any anomalous patterns.
